topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: When I opened the door to find a package addressed to someone I didn't know, I immediately realized it must have been a mix-up. The name on the box was unfamiliar, and after a moment, it clicked that it probably belonged to the previous tenant. I set the package aside, made a note to myself to contact the sender or the post office, and went about my day. It’s a common enough occurrence, and it’s usually not too difficult to sort out. I’ll just need to take a few steps to ensure it gets redirected correctly. For now, I’m content knowing that a bit of patience and a phone call or two will have everything sorted out soon enough.
